verses.1: And when the children of Cain multiplied, they made the lyre and the drum, the harp and the flute, and every kind of instrument, and they sang.
verses.2: And moreover, daughters were born to Cain, beautiful and comely, from the wife of Abel the righteous, whom he had killed; for she was comely, and after he had killed his brother, he took her and made her his wife.
verses.3: And he departed from his father, taking them with him into the valley of Qefaz, by the way of the west; and the children of that comely woman became corrupt, as it were.
verses.4: And at that time the angels came down to the children of Cain, and they did not remain even one hour, but took wives for themselves from among those whom they had chosen.
verses.5: And because of this, God was angry with us and with them, for we were joined together with them in their error because of their transgression.
verses.6: And Satan also deceived our father Adam and our mother Eve into his error, while he tempted them and said to them, 'You shall become like gods, like God your Creator.'
verses.7: But they, by their deeds, believed him like themselves, and transgressed the commandment of their Creator, who had brought them out of nothing into being, that they might worship and praise His holy name.
verses.8: But as for those who forsook the gift of God for themselves, He is their Lord who created them, and He is the great one.
verses.9: As David says, 'In his pride the sinner despises the poor'; for by the pride of Satan, Adam was established in righteousness before God his God.
verses.10: And likewise the angels who sinned with the daughters of Cain joined with us in their transgression; and because of this our days were shortened from the days of our fathers which God had given us.
verses.11: But they did what was good, and there was nothing evil that came near them, for they strengthened their heart toward God, and they taught their sons and their daughters not to depart from the commandment of God which He had commanded them.
verses.12: But as for those who did not do so, and did not tell their children nor teach them, there is no one who will plead for them.
verses.13: As David says, 'And they did not hide from their children, to another generation, but declared His praises to God, and His might and His wonders which He had done'; as these understood, so they taught their children to understand and to do, and to keep His covenant with God, and to keep His commandment, as their fathers who had confessed God by the manner of their deeds.
verses.14: And they did not forsake His commandment which their fathers had commanded them, when they were young, in the fear of God and His covenant, as these were taught by their fathers.
verses.15: And their children also were taught by their fathers to direct their steps aright and to offer praise to their Creator, for they kept His commandment and loved Him.
verses.16: And He hears their prayer and does not forsake them in their days, and He is merciful.
verses.17: With much water He quenches, and He does not burn with all His rebuke.
